decimalCounterValidation: Direct JSON.stringify(Array.from(Float32Array)) byte comparison including negative zero, fractional values, smallest subnormal and largest finite values with three-byte writes; wrong count, partial float and nonfinite input rejected; empty array is two bytes.
scope: Six actual Rust-generated fresh/generation-13 archives, exact Float32 hashes and independent candidate-byte comparisons, exact equivalent numeric JSON array sizes, declared role/container sizes, bounded-block maxima and independent Python codec throughput. Acceleration changes requested step rate only; ordinary physics, sensing, inference, deaths and evolution remain active. Eight-second rounds are fixture preparation, not the 60-second real-time timing gate. Python timings are not Rust production or Oxygen timing; block maxima are not total process-memory measurements. Formal server phase-memory and precise browser-memory gates remain open.
